basis: A clean rebuild of the release source tree (every file listed here) produced comp9 byte-identical to the certified, measured compressor. Release documents added afterwards (README.md, EX-GIRLFRIEND.md, docs/, verification/) are not build inputs.
toolchain: Ubuntu clang/LLVM/lld 18.1.3-1ubuntu1 (pinned packages, placed first on the fixed PATH), GCC 13.3.0 support files selected with --gcc-install-dir, GNU binutils 2.42, Ubuntu 24.04; make -j2
